chunks: The people of Noah had denied before them, and many factions after them. Every nation has intrigued against its apostle and afflicted him, and argued with false arguments to condemn the truth. Then I seized them. How was then My retribution!
ai.seo_question: Who were the people of Noah and the factions that denied their prophets according to Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse highlights the recurring pattern of divine retribution against those who actively conspired to silence the truth, serving as a warning to the Qurayh. Shia exegetes often note that 'Al-Ahzaab' (the factions) refers to the coalition of tribes that defeated the Israelites at Badr, linking this historical event to the broader theme of divine support for the faithful against polytheistic opposition. The verse underscores the inevitability of God's punishment when the powerful use false arguments to suppress the message of their prophets.
